name: The Night Heist
source:
Meet Mariah, Maria, and Missy a group of college girls from Whitson Community College, however like most people who attend college find themselves also working a part-time job trying to pay off their student loans and other bills.

For Mariah, working part time at a shop wasn’t enough.
She wanted more.
More money to not only pay off her loans and bills but for other things she and the girls wanted.

So Mariah and the girls take things into their own hands and began robbing houses at night.
Calling it. The Night Heist.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2738840/]Steam[/url]]
